key_insight: An LLM-orchestrated pipeline can check clinical pathway adherence directly from unstructured notes and guideline text, without needing formal computer-interpretable guidelines.
clinical_relevance: This could make guideline conformance auditing more practical for hospitals that lack structured guideline models, supporting quality improvement in stroke care.
method: Extracted patient traces from discharge letters with LLM support
Identified normative rules from textual clinical guidelines
Translated rules into executable scripts and computed a Trace Conformance Indicator
evidence_signal: In an evaluation at Alessandria Hospital, hundreds of stroke patient traces were assessed against 50 guideline rules, and more than 86% were conformant.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable LLM extraction and rule translation, so accuracy, transparency, and generalizability beyond one hospital setting need careful validation.
paper_title: LLM-Orchestrated Conformance Checking in Stroke Care Without Computer-Interpretable Guidelines
